upstream.attribution: The production inflater is a guarded fork, not unmodified upstream. Retain upstream copyright/license and the exact reconstruction recipe.
upstream.recorded_paths_scope: Paths inside the unchanged upstream provenance receipt refer to an earlier repository layout; portable copies retain the same vendor-relative layout under third_party/fflate.

classification: Guarded fixed-output research fork. Core copied byte-for-byte from the sealed CPU component experiment; no package or remote runtime import.

wrapper_extraction.prefix: Production comment and production-local core import only.
wrapper_extraction.method: Concatenate exact original source substrings with exclusive end markers; this includes require, BASE, adler32, footer and boundedFflate only.

contract: One synchronous CPU inflate; Uint8Array body8..4096, exact output1..4096, fixed output allocation, exact raw-deflate end extent and Adler32, CINFO-declared maximum history, strict default-zlib tree grammar/reserved-symbol and available-distance checks. No automatic fallback.
